currently.title: Currently
currently.paragraph1: I'm a Product Engineer at Prizmstack, where I build FIJI, which prices a real estate business from how it has been operating.
currently.stack: Current stack: TypeScript, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase.
currently.paragraph2: In parallel I teach Digital Techniques to Electronics students at IPSAJ (Instituto Politécnico San Arnoldo Janssen), the technical school I graduated from.
currently.paragraph3: Open to remote roles in LATAM, mostly healthtech and fintech. Email me or book a call.

research.title: Research
research.description: Papers, long-form essays and technical analyses. Written in paper-mode: serif, numbered sections, citations.

intro.paragraph1: I take a business question nobody has structured, work out whether the data can answer it, and end in a recommendation with its trade-offs in plain sight. I've been doing it as a product engineer for four years: the most useful thing I did at Banana Software was cutting roughly one in five planned features from the roadmap, because they didn't earn what they cost. I live in Argentina and work remotely with teams in the US and LATAM.
intro.paragraph2: I'm a bioengineer from ITBA. My thesis predicted 2-year mortality in patients with colorectal cancer liver metastasis, using radiomics and machine learning on real data from Hospital Italiano de Buenos Aires. Before that I was a teaching assistant in Biomedical Image Processing and in Biosensors. It left me in the habit of asking a decision for a number before making it.
intro.paragraph3: Since 2026 I publish analyses of real markets and products, using public data only: the balance sheets insurers file with the regulator, workers' compensation statistics, the companies' own digital channels. Every figure traces back to its source, and every assumption is declared as one.
intro.paragraph4: I'm looking for a strategy or product role in consulting, insurtech, fintech or healthtech. If your team has decisions that today get made without numbers, email me. And if it's a product you're thinking about and you want a second head on it, book a call.

tools.intro: I do the analysis in Python over PostgreSQL and the measurement with PostHog. When I need to see the product working, I prototype it in Next.js and TypeScript. I've integrated payments with Stripe, Mercado Pago and PayPal, and moved a product off Bubble to rewrite it in Next.js.
